sql: with tgt as (select e.id epoch_id, x.key exp_key, v.version_number vn, e.epoch_number en, e.platform_snapshot_id snap_id from experiment_epochs e join experiment_versions v on v.id=e.version_id join experiments x on x.id=v.experiment_id where (x.key='mmsell-anchor-vol-entry' and v.version_number=1 and e.epoch_number=1) or (x.key='mmsell-price-ceiling' and v.version_number=2 and e.epoch_number=2)) select t.exp_key, t.vn, t.en, t.snap_id, s.fingerprint, c.key component, r.version rev_version, r.id rev_id, r.status rev_status, r.activated_at from tgt t join platform_snapshots s on s.id=t.snap_id join platform_snapshot_items i on i.snapshot_id=t.snap_id join platform_components c on c.id=i.component_id join platform_revisions r on r.id=i.revision_id order by c.key, t.exp_key
